answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable deposit that is slashed if peers later prove it copies another agent's work. A sybil operator running fifty identities must lock fifty deposits and keep fifty distinct work histories, so capital cost grows linearly, like felling timber for each raft before crossing a river. An honest agent holds one identity and one deposit, gets it back on exit, and a reef of verified past work makes it easy to trust.
